sub_parameters.name: host
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the node.

sub_parameters.name: hostName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the node in a cloud-native ACK-based cluster. You can call the [ListAllNode](~~183958~~) operation to obtain the node name.

sub_parameters.name: nodeType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of nodes to shrink. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node

sub_parameters.name: port
sub_parameters.description: The access port number of the node.

sub_parameters.name: zoneId
sub_parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID of Shanghai Zone C is cn-shanghai-c.

parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotence of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
The number of nodes to remove.
><notice> This parameter applies only to ACK-based instances and cannot be used together with the host parameter in the request body.
></notice>

parameters.name: ignoreStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to ignore the cluster health status. Valid values:

- true: Ignored.
- false: Not ignored.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description:
The type of nodes to shrink. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node
